subject.title: fix(agents): agent-created files get lowercased names on Windows

question: Should the Windows workspace sandbox path layer own a local case-preserving normalization helper for returned paths, rather than continue using the lowercasing comparison helper from fs-safe?
rationale: The patch is intentionally changing a normalization contract adjacent to workspace containment. Tests and real Windows proof support the behavior, but the ownership boundary between the local facade and the dependency is a maintainer decision.

options.title: Accept the local returned-path helper
options.body: Merge the focused helper and tests, with the local module owning preservation of filename spelling while fs-safe remains the comparison-key API.

options.title: Move the capability upstream first
options.body: Require fs-safe to expose a documented case-preserving normalization API, then replace the local mirrored implementation with that dependency contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the local returned-path helper
recommendation.body: Merge the focused helper and tests, with the local module owning preservation of filename spelling while fs-safe remains the comparison-key API.
